args.topic: verify crime statistics claim against FBI UCR data

sql: SELECT ori, agency_name, state_abbr FROM crime.cde_agencies WHERE state_abbr='NY' AND agency_name ILIKE '%new york city%'
SELECT year, month, actual_murder, number_of_months_reported FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori LIKE 'NY0303000%' AND year IN (2024,2025,2026) ORDER BY year, month
SELECT DISTINCT ori FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori LIKE 'NY0303%'
SELECT year, month, actual_murder, actual_robbery_total, actual_all_crimes, number_of_months_reported FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori = 'NY03030' AND year IN (2024,2025,2026) ORDER BY year, month
SELECT year, SUM(actual_murder) AS murders_jun_aug FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori='NY03030' AND month IN (6,7,8) AND year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2025 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT ori, agency_name FROM crime.cde_agencies WHERE state_abbr='NY' AND (agency_name ILIKE '%rochester%' OR agency_name ILIKE '%utica%' OR agency_name ILIKE '%poughkeepsie%' OR agency_name ILIKE '%buffalo%') AND agency_name NOT ILIKE '%county%'

SELECT ori,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN actual_all_crimes ELSE 0 END) AS idx_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year=2026 AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN actual_all_crimes ELSE 0 END) AS idx_2026
FROM crime.cde_reta
WHERE ori IN ('NY02701','NY03202','NY01302')
GROUP BY ori
